visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and a vibrant pink scarf speaks excitedly to the camera in what appears to be a motorcycle showroom. She stands in front of a white banner labeled 'TTLBT' and a light brick-patterned wall. (2) She moves toward a dark blue SYM maxi-scooter, mounting it while a man in a black shirt and blue medical mask stands behind the bike. She demonstrates the bike's ergonomic fit while gripping the handlebars firmly. (3) The camera pans down to a close-up of her tan platform boots, showing that she can comfortably touch the ground with her heels while seated on the vehicle, proving the bike's accessibility for her height. (4) Returning to an upper body shot, she gives two thumbs up to the camera while continuing her narration, expressing her approval and satisfaction with the vehicle's design. (5) The scene shifts to a candid shot of another man with reddish-brown hair laughing heartily at something off-camera. The background shows a crowd of people in a dimly lit event space, suggesting a lively and festive atmosphere.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with high pitch and fast delivery. An upbeat electronic pop background track with synthesized drums begins immediately, establishing a positive, promotional tone. (2) A bright 'ding' sound effect punctuates her speech as she gestures, marking a visual emphasis. Faint ambient chatter from a crowd is audible in the background, reinforcing the showroom setting. (3) Mechanical scraping and a distinct metallic 'click' occur as the speaker interacts with the motorcycle's kickstand. Her voice remains dominant, projecting clear excitement over the steady rhythm of the BGM. (4) A whimsical cartoon-style 'pop' sound effect is heard during a scene transition, maintaining the playful variety-show editing style. The music maintains a constant, energetic tempo throughout the demonstration. (5) A male voice enters at the very end with a low-pitched laugh and a short comment, interacting with the primary speaker. The background music swells slightly before cutting off with the video.
